en: Two people, as different as can be
Opposites in every single way

ko: 함께 있을 때면 왠지 참 좋은 걸요
en: Yet somehow, together, it just feels right
Wait, how is it that
everything you do is a little off-beat?
Why on earth?
Why not just do what everyone does?
Why do you keep doing that?
Everyone is looking at you
Doesn't it bother you? It would bother me
Look or not, you don't seem to mind
Or maybe you want the attention
and secretly, you enjoy it
I never knew someone so unlike me existed
How can someone, from head to toe,
be so different from me?
I had truly never seen anyone like you
So I kept looking
I was amazed, truly fascinated

ko: 나와 다른 게 그걸 바라보는 게 좋았어
en: How different you are, I loved watching it
Do you feel the same, watching me?
Why are you looking at me, huh?
I think I'm falling in love
even though we're so different
Love is such a mystery

ko: 살아 가면서 한 번 올까 말까 한
en: the kind that comes once in a lifetime, if ever
that kind of love
I think it has found me
It's not quite what I dreamed of
but we make each other smile
Whenever I'm by your side
I can't help but feel happy
I think I'm falling in love
